verdict.rationale: Real-time multi-session collaboration is a fair question for a collaborative board tool like Trello, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents live updates across open sessions without refreshing. Calendar sync, webhooks (a developer building block), card mirroring and community praise for a 'responsive UI' are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
